title: Jesus Christ walks on water
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates Jesus walking on water (Matthew 14:22-33) and lists lessons: faith, call on Jesus when afraid, power over nature.

floor.question: What did Jesus do to the storm?

representations: a blue cloth for the lake
Peter's words on a card: "Lord, save me!"
contexts: a child afraid of the dark

board.do: Wait for the child to say Peter, because he was sinking.

misconceptions.ask: How did the disciples feel when they saw Jesus walking on the water?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 14:26 and act out fright at a shape in the dark.

misconceptions.ask: When did Peter begin to sink?
misconceptions.repair: Read Matthew 14:29-30: he walked, then looked at the wind.

misconceptions.ask: Where was Jesus when the disciples were in the boat at night?
misconceptions.repair: Put the two story pictures side by side and spot differences.

misconceptions.ask: What is a lesson from Jesus walking on water?
misconceptions.repair: Ask what Peter cried out and what Jesus said about faith.

checks.question: What did the disciples think Jesus was?
Why did Peter begin to sink?
checks.answer: He saw the wind and was afraid
